summary: Help rests a fist (thumb up) on top of a flat palm and lifts both together. Move it toward someone to help them, toward yourself to ask for help.
handshape: A/10 hand (fist, thumb up) on a flat B hand
steps: Hold your non-dominant hand flat, palm up.
Place a fist with the thumb up on top of it.
Lift both hands together a few inches. To say 'help me,' move the unit toward your chest; to say 'help you,' move it toward the person.
note: HELP is a directional verb. The direction of movement replaces the pronoun, so HELP-YOU and HELP-ME are the same sign going opposite ways.
mistakes: Lifting only the top hand. Both hands rise together as one unit.

faq.q: How do I sign 'I need help'?
faq.a: Sign NEED (a bent index finger pushing down) and then HELP moving toward yourself. There's a dedicated I-NEED-HELP phrase page too.
